title: Online Multiplayer Fall Guys Clone in a 90-minute session with Astra
author: IntelligentSand8748
selftext:
Made with Astra and colyseus as the multiplayer engine (such a great OSS project!). Supports 3 concurrent lobbies of 10 players.

Play link: [https://striped-woodpecker.apps.podda.app/](https://striped-woodpecker.apps.podda.app/)

comments.author: duffpl
comments.body: What's the point of these clones?

replies.author: IntelligentSand8748
replies.body: It's just a test of the model - I think it's pretty crazy to come out the back of 90 minutes with this as a result.

comments.author: ErsterEffzeh
comments.body: Does not look buggy at all! I'd say ship it as is.

replies.author: IntelligentSand8748
replies.body: /s the recording is causing some glitching - without that it's pretty smooth.

comments.author: Negative-Act-2116
comments.body: No idea why people ask what the point is or downvote you, this is a game, developed by ai, and it's in r/aigamedev. Makes perfect sense to me, looks cool dude nice little showcase of what it can do.
